TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_NO_PATTERN_TO_COUNTER.why: Partially automated: the qualified check/save consumers exist, but production effects do not yet declare predictive movement control.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_NO_PATTERN_TO_COUNTER.manual_handling: No Pattern to Counter is partially automated. The table does not yet identify predictive movement control in ordinary techniques. While holding Martial Focus, ask the Game Master to apply Advantage to your saving throw or ability check against an effect that predicts, reads, locks, traces, or punishes your movement pattern. This costs no additional resource and applies only to that roll; ordinary sight and senses do not qualify.

TAL_AIR_WIND_SENSE.why: Partially automated: the qualified check consumer exists, but ordinary Search and scene checks do not yet supply air-disturbance context. The separate Invisible Blade Current interaction remains automated.
TAL_AIR_WIND_SENSE.manual_handling: Wind-Sense is partially automated. Ordinary Search does not yet identify current air disturbances. Ask the Game Master to apply Advantage to your Wisdom (Perception) check to notice moving creatures within 30 feet, incoming projectiles, gas, smoke, pressure changes, or airflow around a sealed door. This costs no additional resource and applies only to that check. Motionless creatures and airtight barriers do not qualify; hidden moving creatures cannot be behind Total Cover, and superior stealth, illusion, or Void concealment requires an opposed check. It does not automatically reveal a location or grant sight.
